evidence.ref: .warp/tracker.py load_tracker_config reads a per-org .warp/trackers.json (warp.tracker/v1) or returns {} if absent, and _validate rejects (TrackerConfigError) a bad schema, a missing/bad routing mechanism, a label mechanism with no prefix, a field mechanism with no field, a repo missing id/tracker/project, and a duplicate repo id - a malformed config never silently no-ops.

selftest asserts the validation rejections and a disk load; independent review confirmed load returns {} when absent, raises on malformed JSON, and the shipped template validates; part of selftest 1068 passed, 0 failed

.warp/tracker.py resolve_repo(ticket, config) returns the exactly-one repo a ticket targets by the configured mechanism (a label with the prefix, a component, or a named field) and raises TrackerRoutingError when the signal is missing, ambiguous, or (for the explicit label/field mechanisms) names an unknown repo - it never guesses.

selftest asserts label/component/field resolution and missing/unknown/ambiguous refusals; independent review confirmed fail-closed across all three mechanisms and that the component asymmetry (unknown component filtered, but a ticket whose only component is unknown raises no-signal) lets no misroute slip through; part of selftest 1068 passed, 0 failed
.warp/tracker.py tracker_for_repo(repo_id, config) returns {tracker, project} for a declared repo and raises TrackerRoutingError by name for an undeclared repo.
selftest asserts the known-repo return and the undeclared-repo raise; part of selftest 1068 passed, 0 failed

.warp/tracker.py imports only json and os, does a single file read, and never writes or hits the network - deterministic (config in, answer out). A template ships at plugin/templates/.warp/trackers.json.
independent review confirmed no network/writes/subprocess and determinism; the template validates; part of selftest 1068 passed, 0 failed

a selftest drives the resolver over temporary configs and tickets - label/component/field resolution and missing/unknown/ambiguous/malformed refusals plus a disk load - and asserts the non-tautology (the routing signal present resolves, removed it refuses).
independent review proved the teeth: mutating resolve_repo to always return the first repo (a guesser) turns the refuses and non-tautology assertions RED; gate GREEN, selftest 1068 passed, 0 failed
